title: Amendment agreements

voice.rule: No voice: the Parties act in the third person (the Agency shall …).

spelling.rule: British -ise (authorised, utilisation, organisation), although the firm's agreement bases still carry -ize: change it as you write.

cross_refs.rule: Refer to the Principal Agreement's provisions with its own word (Clause or Section) and their headings: Clause [●] (Notices).

headings.rule: Title Case with every word capitalised, small words too: Grant Of Rights, Deposits & Withdrawals From Accounts. Schedules: Schedule A – [Title].

dates.preamble: as of this [●] day of [●], [●] (the Amendment Effective Date)

parties_close.text: (the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns)

rollup.text: (the [●] and the [●] are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Parties and each individually as a Party).

recitals_open.text: Recitals: The Parties entered into an agreement entitled ‘[●]’ dated [●] (the Principal Agreement), pursuant to which … / The Parties now agree that certain amendments are required in the Principal Agreement, which amendments form the subject matter of this Amendment Agreement.

now_therefore.text: Now, Therefore, the Parties hereby agree as follows:

testimonium.text: In Witness Whereof, the Parties hereto have caused this Amendment Agreement to be executed on the day, month and year first above mentioned.

execution.text: As [Party] / For and on behalf of [●] through its authorised signatory / Name: / Designation: / in the presence of / Witnesses: / Name: / Address: / CNIC / Passport No:

governing_law.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

arbitration.text: No default: the seat, the rules (Arbitration Act, 1940 or institutional, e.g. SIAC), the number of arbitrators and the venue are always asked as a drafting question; the firm's files differ (a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration Act, 1940; a board of three under the Arbitration Act, 1940; SIAC seated in Singapore).

preamble.text: This ‘[●] Amendment Agreement’ (this Amendment Agreement) is made and entered into as of this [●] day of [●], [●] (the Amendment Effective Date):

parties.text: By And Between: [●], a company incorporated under the laws of [●], having its principal office at [●] (the [First Party]); And … (the [First Party] and the [Second Party] are hereinafter referred to individually as a Party and collectively as the Parties).

lead_in.text: Pursuant to Clause [●] (Amendment) of the Principal Agreement, the Parties hereby agree that the Principal Agreement shall be amended as follows.

replace.text: … [the provision] shall stand deleted in its entirety and shall stand replaced with the following:

insert.text: In Clause [●] (Definitions) of the Principal Agreement, immediately before the term ‘[●]’ and its definition, a new term ‘[●]’ and its definition shall stand inserted as follows:

effect.text: This Amendment Agreement shall become effective on the Amendment Effective Date.

unchanged.text: Except as otherwise expressly set out in this Amendment Agreement, all other provisions of the Principal Agreement shall remain unchanged.

incorporation.text: Clause [●] (Notices) … and Clause [●] (Dispute Resolution) of the Principal Agreement shall apply to this Amendment Agreement, mutatis mutandis.

banned.pattern: \bshall be deleted in its entirety and replaced with\b
banned.reason: The firm writes "shall stand deleted in its entirety and shall stand replaced with the following".

tells_of_counterparty.tell: "has the meaning given to it in" pointers
"(hereinafter referred to as the X which expression shall mean and include …)" with no "where the context so permits"
parties called "the Company" rather than by role (the Concessionaire, the Project Company)
money with the words first: Pakistani Rupees [words] (PKR [●])

defined_terms.pointer_formula: shall bear the meanings ascribed thereto in the Principal Agreement
defined_terms.lead_in: Unless otherwise defined in this Amendment Agreement, all capitalised terms used but not defined herein shall bear the meanings ascribed thereto in the Principal Agreement.
defined_terms.rule: Defined terms of this Amendment Agreement are bold in brackets without quotation marks; a definition inserted into the Principal Agreement follows the Principal Agreement's own style (quoted if it quotes).

notes: The amended agreement is "the Principal Agreement", never "the Original Agreement".
The pack's preamble year is [●], not a fixed year.
